title: Invariant and Super-median Functions for Perturbed Heat Kernels
summary: We study super-median and invariant functions for positive and negative Schrödinger perturbations of non-negative kernels. For positive perturbations, combining Dynkin's formula for the original kernel with Duhamel's formula for the perturbation, we derive perturbed Dynkin-type identities and give integrability conditions ensuring invariance. When the perturbed kernel is given by the perturbation series, we obtain a sufficient condition for a function to be super-median without additional integrability assumptions.
